name: Reliability-Weighted Basis Evidence

basis.U: same fixed fit-oracle top32 U as B
basis.H: MLP(c):64->64->256; reshape8x32; normalize each row by max(row_norm,1e-6)
basis.feature_reconstruction: c+ka*Pa; original patient feature bypass retained

noise_meta_model.fit_stage: R=I during main fit; reliability weights learned only during source-cal curriculum
noise_meta_model.cal_target: (o-H*zstar)^2 on source-cal oracle latents; observation and bases frozen
noise_meta_model.curriculum: progress=(step+1)/256; extra support RGB Gaussian std=.04*progress, feature Gaussian std=.02*progress; zstar refers to nominal anchor, not re-fit to the extra noise; independent keyed RNG
noise_meta_model.deployment_missing_features: hard fail, no silent all-reliable fallback

update.solve: (H.T diag(nu/R) H /512 + lambda I) znew = H.T diag(nu/R)o/512 +lambda*zminus
update.differentiation_source: differentiate unrolled3 solves; R fixed1 in main fit

static: zprev=0 before every visit; independently fit and calibrated at same budgets
main_ablation: C_CONST_R: replace patch variance by channelwise geometric mean source-cal variances (8 values) frozen before target; retain robust Huber and history, same full checkpoint
falsifiers: R predictions do not track proxy residuals under source-heldout noise
heteroscedastic robust update does not help versus frozen constant variance
basis reconstruction improves without segment improvement
